c1_decision.revision_trigger: C2 run 37003640318 exposed that request-local schema evidence and policy-only draft rules were incorrectly acting as hard correctness boundaries for editable example Terraform

operating_boundary.generated_result_role: editable/reference Terraform draft; not an unattended plan/apply artifact
operating_boundary.corpus_role: curated project patterns, decisions, relationships and representative examples; not a provider allowlist
operating_boundary.schema_role: authoritative local AWS resource existence/schema source for the exact bundled provider
operating_boundary.schema_distribution: generated during backend image build from the exact bundled provider; not fetched from the public registry at request time

request_context_contract: pre-generation schema context is the bounded union of fact resource types, retrieved-reference resourceTypes metadata, and AWS resource blocks found in retrieved reference content
request-specific schema context is advisory prompt evidence and is not a generated-resource allowlist
a generated AWS resource may be emitted even when absent from request schema context if the exact local AWS 5.100.0 provider catalog contains it
generated AWS resource blocks must exist in the exact local provider catalog
module blocks and non-AWS deployable providers remain outside the current product scope
draft_validation_contract: policy-only rejection of literal password/secret/token-like values is removed
policy-only rejection of account IDs and account-scoped ARNs is removed
placeholder/TODO/example wording does not by itself invalidate structurally usable Terraform
Terraform init -backend=false -get=false and terraform validate -json remain the final executable correctness checks
recovery_contract: generation provider-call budget remains at most two
the existing output-truncation compact retry is the only generation retry path
contract and Terraform CLI failures do not gain automatic regeneration
diagnostic_contract: C2 failure evidence is derived from the job-correlated terminal AnalysisJob failure category rather than the first arbitrary category token
Terraform CLI bounded failure categories remain
raw generated Terraform, credentials, and unbounded CLI output are not emitted as diagnostic labels/artifacts
rejected: use request-local schema context as a generated-resource allowlist
reject example Terraform solely for literal credentials, account IDs, account-scoped ARNs, placeholders, or TODO wording
keep generation grounded only to the current curated corpus
embed and ingest the entire AWS Provider documentation set into OpenSearch
query the public Terraform Registry dynamically on each analysis request
enable modules or non-AWS providers as part of this correction

c2_decision.pass_rule: all five sequential attempts satisfy the frozen integrated correctness contract under one exact runtime identity
c2_decision.rerun_rule: no automatic whole-gate rerun; failed or external-variance-inconclusive execution requires a new user checkpoint
live_prerequisite: publish one immutable backend image from the exact approved main SHA using the existing GCP Backend Image Publish workflow
roll out that exact digest using the existing backend-revision-rollout operation
run one separately approved protected C2 five-request gate

portfolio_closure_override.rule: Do not rerun solely for portfolio closure; preserve the failed gate as residual-risk evidence.
